$comment: Input of scripts/generate_name_inventory.py and scripts/refresh_name_inventory.py. Repository names only. repoPatterns: repositories whose AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/docs lists go into the inventory and that the drift check treats as repositories. nodeRepoPatterns: repositories scanned for [NodeName] registrations. extraRepos: cloned by the weekly refresh even without a local checkout (plug repositories whose nodes the skills describe). excludeRepos: never cloned or listed (octo-mesh-deployment is not hosted on GitHub and holds no docs the skills point to). requiredRepos (plus cmdletRepo and cliRepo): the refresh fails when one of them is missing, instead of dropping its names.
